decisions.reason: It is highly related to our core heat-exchanger knowledge and its promotion from a website mention to a dedicated page suggests enough market and learning potential to justify continued commercialization and improvement.
It builds directly on capabilities we already possess, and the move to a dedicated page indicates positive internal assessment and sufficient absorptive capacity to refine and scale it.

This corrosion-repair liner fits our installed-base service business and draws on adjacent technical knowledge, so we can keep learning from field use and improve it with our engineering and research links.
A customized industrial air cooler is close to our established offer and suits our solution-oriented model, making it a good candidate to retain even if it remains a niche product.

Tube-end repair inserts extend our lifecycle-service offering and use knowledge we already have in heat-exchanger maintenance, giving us a strong basis to absorb feedback and enhance the product commercially.
